title: Individual Patient Expanded Access IND to Treat Polyneuropathy
brief_summary: This Individual Patient Expanded Access IND has been created as requested by an 58-year-old man who suffers from Polyneuropathy due to Polyneuropathy, Organomegaly, Endocrinopathy, Monoclonal gammopathy, and Skin abnormalities (POEMS) Syndrome. The patient will receive 8 infusions of 200 million cells every four weeks during a 28-week period to relieve the symptoms of Polyneuropathy arising due to POEMS.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria

* Patient diagnosed with Polyneuropathy due to POEMS Syndrome.
* Patient must have banked his stem cells at Hope Biosciences LLC.

Exclusion Criteria

* The patient has any active infection requiring medications.
* The patient has any suicidal ideation during the screening visit.
